messages:
maya: Quick update — Hosted API: Astra model family + Unified Toolflow are rolling to GA today (regional phased rollout).

maya: What this is: Astra is a set of compact + high-throughput models tuned for low-latency web inference. Unified Toolflow is our new streaming + tool-calling surface that combines tool-calls, streaming tokens, and structured output in one endpoint.

maya: Key highlights:
- per-route regional pinning (region_hint) to keep traffic local
- new request param `latency_tier` (low | balanced | high_throughput)
- automatic fallback to compatible Astra-lite quant variants
- unified metrics emitted: per-token cost, kv-cache hit rate, tool-call success

maya: Example request (new endpoint: POST /v2/unified/generate):
```
POST /v2/unified/generate
Content-Type: application/json
x-api-version: 2026-03
{
  "model": "astra-1b-servo",
  "input": "summarize the Q1 infra changes",
  "toolflow": { "tools": ["search", "code_executor"] },
  "stream": true,
  "region_hint": "us-west-2",
  "latency_tier": "low"
}
```

maya: Rollout plan:
- 09:00 UTC: canary (5% traffic) + integration tests
- 12:00 UTC: 25% (expand to more regions)
- 18:00 UTC: broad GA (all hosted customers)

maya: Deprecations & callouts: legacy streaming endpoint /v1/stream will be deprecated in 60 days. We’ll auto-provide a migration shim for most clients but teams using custom websockets should verify. SDK patches landing in the next hour.

kevin: Congrats! Nice work — SDK teams: expect `@redwood/sdk` 2.8.0 with unified client helpers and new region_hint param.

lena: Ops note: canary will route through the new autoscaler. Watch the dashboard for queue depth > 0. I’ll post a short runbook in #eng-oncall.

dan: Pricing heads-up: Astra-lite quant variants will be 30% cheaper per-token than equivalent baseline models. Dedicated customers with reserved capacity will keep current metering unless they opt-in.

maria: Product ask — please add a short migration checklist for partners (examples for Websocket -> unified streaming + toolflow). I can take the doc and produce a partner digest.

deploy-bot: deploy started: service/unified-gateway v1.0.0 -> canary (commit ab12c3f). CI: green. :rocket:

kevin: FYI — some advanced tool-calling patterns that used synchronous tool RPC will now prefer async tool events. See the notes I pushed to the SDK PR.

maya: If your team owns a public integration or has compliance constraints, ping me or @maria before 15:00 UTC so we can hold a dedicated rollout window.

lena: I’ll schedule a quick ops-check at canary start and post metrics in this thread.

kevin: ACK — will monitor SDK telemetry and report any serialization issues.

maria: Thanks all. Will follow up with partner digest + migration checklist in ~2h. :thumbsup:

maya: huge thanks to infra, runtime, product, and docs for getting this across the line. Please flag any regressions in #eng-runtime or here.

deploy-bot: canary health: 200 OK on probe, avg p95 latency 48ms (us-west-2) — continuing rollout.

kevin: small note — if anyone sees a spike in kv cache misses, tag @lena so she can adjust cache sizing quickly.

maria: Partner digest posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/astra-migration (internal).
